blocks.body: Ship a small valid Kitepump (or flower-docs) publication: map, keys, one reuse, completeness clean, and a local WebHelp or a recorded transform attempt.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 110 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: The Oxygen half
blocks.body:
This is the handbook proof. You already know every piece.

- A **map** with at least six topics
- A **key** for the product name, used twice
- One **reused warning**
- **Completeness** clean
- A **transform** (WebHelp, or a failure you then repaired)

Copy into `oxygen-bootcamp-work/week12/`. Do not replace the samples in the repo.

Local WebHelp is a draft if Guides is the release. Say so in the log.

blocks.title: Creating a Publishing Template to Customize WebHelp and PDF using CSS

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: Completeness is dirty, or reuse is copy-paste, or you skipped the transform log.

Expected: Clean completeness. Key plus reuse. Transform evidence.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Work in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week12/, not inside samples/. Copy what you need.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Map with at least six topics, or a documented subset of flower-docs plus kitepump. Completeness clean.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: One key (product name) used twice. One reused warning (conkeyref or conref).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: One ditaval, or a written reason you did not filter.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: WebHelp Responsive, or a failed transform you then repaired (the week 6 skill).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Note: local output is a draft if Guides is the release on your desk.

blocks.summary: Clean completeness. Key plus reuse. Transform evidence.

blocks.q: The HTML opened. Completeness still shows a missing link. Are you done?
options: Yes :  if it opened, it shipped
No :  fix the missing link. Completeness is the gate
Yes if the folder is named FINAL
blocks.why: A site can open and still miss a page. Completeness names the miss.

blocks.q: The product name is typed by hand in six topics. What should it have been?
options: A key in the map, used twice or more
blocks.why: Week 4: the map owns the name. Topics point at it.
